btx-capability — owner-local BTX capability CLI (0.34.8-dev)
Local resolve/plan/ensure/load only. Never public HTTP.
Not a remote inference marketplace. automatic_spend_atoms stays 0.
btx-open remains inspect-only; this binary does not install, spend, or run inference.
Readiness is lease_id + generation, never a naked filesystem path.

Flags:
  -capabilitysocket=<path>  unix JSON-RPC (default: <modeldir>/capabilityd.sock)
  -modeldir=<dir>            catalog directory (never wallet/chainstate)
  --json                    machine JSON for status/get
  --spend                   rejected

Primary commands (spec 21.2; mapped only when registered):
  btx-capability ensure <path.btx|--recipe json|--plan-id ID> [--policy personal] [--ready first-useful-result]    # ensurebtxcapability
  btx-capability prefetch [--lock <lock>] [--recipe <json>] [--deadline <duration>]    # prefetchbtxcapability
  btx-capability status JOB|LEASE [--json]    # getbtxcapability
  btx-capability get JOB|LEASE [--json]    # getbtxcapability
  btx-capability sleep LEASE    # sleepbtxcapability
  btx-capability wake LEASE    # wakebtxcapability
  btx-capability update --preview    # planbtxcapabilityupdate
  btx-capability release LEASE    # releasebtxcapability
  btx-capability cancel JOB    # cancelbtxcapability
  btx-capability resolve ...    # resolvebtxcapability
  btx-capability plan ...    # planbtxcapability
  btx-capability switch OLD NEW    # switchbtxcapability
  btx-capability events     # getbtxcapabilityevents
  btx-capability ttc JOB    # getbtxttctrace
  btx-capability residency     # getbtxresidency
  btx-capability inspect-map <hex|{json}>    # inspectbtxtensormap
  btx-capability export-lock <recipe_id|{json}>    # exportbtxlock
  btx-capability import-lock <recipe_id|{json}>    # importbtxlock
  btx-capability capabilities     # getbtxruntimecapabilities
  btx-capability help
